prompt: A very rich, waxy man of indeterminate age with unnaturally smooth, taut skin, bright white teeth and swept-back silver-blond hair sits at a long white table inside a glass house, filmed by a fixed lens placed low and near him on the table. Hundreds of pills in small neat rows of white, brown and yellow cover the table in front of him, and he holds a single capsule between thumb and finger, looking into the lens with a serene, unblinking smile. Behind him are floor-to-ceiling glass walls onto a pale lawn and a pale sky, and the light is flat, bright, overcast daylight bouncing off white surfaces, a little overexposed at the windows. Slightly over-sharpened, desaturated colours and mild compression. Thanks.
